content.Guideline: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

Topics.Title: Anticoagulation for Device-Detected Atrial High-Rate Episodes Among Patients Without a Previous Diagnosis of AF
Key Points: Subclinical atrial fibrillation is associated with increased stroke risk.
Anticoagulation strategies vary from aspirin to more potent anticoagulants based on stroke risk evaluation.

Topics.Title: Percutaneous Approaches to Occlude the LAA
Key Points: Left atrial appendage occlusion is used as a strategy to prevent stroke.
It's especially considered for patients who have contraindications for anticoagulation therapy.

Topics.Title: Cardiac Surgery—LAA Exclusion/Excision
Key Points: Surgical exclusion of the left atrial appendage is performed during cardiac surgery to prevent stroke.
There is ongoing evaluation of its effectiveness, especially in high-risk patients.
